title: catalog: introduce compatibility matrix + queryable pricing/limits filters for model-list API and OpenAI-compat harmonization
author: Aisha Banerjee
description:
Motivation: product and SDK teams need a single, queryable model-list endpoint that surfaces model capabilities, OpenAI-compat flags, and pricing/limits metadata so clients can filter for models that support streaming, function/tool calling, structured output, and particular compatibility layers. This PR adds a compatibility matrix to the model catalog API, exposes pricing_tier and token_limits fields for server-side filtering, and harmonizes the OpenAI compatibility flags across the HTTP API and SDKs.

What this changes: added query parameters: ?capability=streaming|functions|structured_output, ?compat=openai|redwood, ?pricing_tier=free|standard|enterprise, ?max_context=<int>. The model-list response now includes a top-level capabilities list (strings), a compatibility object flattened into compatibility_flags (strings), and pricing_tier and token_limits (max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens). We also add a compatibility_version string for models with multiple compat modes.

Migration notes: clients using the old openai_compat boolean should migrate to compatibility_flags= ["openai_v1"] or use compat=openai query param. SDKs updated in this PR provide helpers get_compatibility() to map legacy fields. Backwards compatibility: the endpoint still returns legacy openai_compat boolean for one release cycle (deprecated).

Testing and rollout: unit tests added for route and handler, integration tests cover query combinations, and a small canary in the hosted catalog was run for 48h. Docs (api/model_catalog.md) updated with examples.

Checklist:
- [x] API route and handler implementation
- [x] SDK mappings (Python + TS)
- [x] Tests (unit + integration)
- [x] Docs and migration notes
- [x] DB migration for compat flags

Notes: this intentionally keeps the model compatibility semantics permissive (string tags) to allow future capabilities to be introduced without schema migrations.

Aisha Banerjee: Good call — switched to kebab-case and expanded docs with allowed tags. Field is compatibility_flags as requested.
Eve Martinez: Tests look good. One nit: add an integration case for compat=openai + capability=functions to ensure ordering of predicates is preserved.
Aisha Banerjee: Added the integration case and a comment in the route explaining predicate short-circuiting for performance.
Lina Cho: SDK change LGTM. Please add a quick example in the TS README showing how to call models.list({capability: 'streaming'}) and handle legacy openai_compat fallback.
Aisha Banerjee: Added TS example and a deprecation note in the Python mapping helper.
release_notes: Added: model-list query filters for capability, compat, pricing_tier, and max_context. Response: compatibility_flags, compatibility_version, pricing_tier, max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens. SDKs: helpers for mapping legacy OpenAI compat boolean. Deprecated: top-level openai_compat boolean (kept for one release).
changelog_entry: Model catalog: queryable capability and compatibility filters; pricing/limits surfaced for server-side filtering; OpenAI-compat harmonized across API and SDKs.
notes_for_support: Support should be aware that queries using compat=openai will map to compatibility_flags containing 'openai_v1' and that older clients using openai_compat boolean may receive a deprecation warning header 'X-Compat-Deprecated: openai_compat'.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Announce deprecation and migration guide in #product-api channel. 2) Schedule removal of legacy openai_compat boolean in two sprints. 3) Monitor catalog traffic for filter-heavy queries and adjust DB indices if needed.
sdk_updates: Python: added Model.compatibility_flags property and redwood.models.map_compatibility() helper
TypeScript: models.ListModelsOptions now accepts capability and compat string params; added docs example
